entry.title: Parser by hand
entry.summary: Last year, I stumbled upon this dude somehow writing a SQLite parser by hand in Rust: Turso PR. Parsing probably sounds scary if you come from a high-level language, but the TL;DR is simple: parsing just generates the AST structure from tokens/code. As always in CS, the devil is in the details—so I decided to write my own parser.
